traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Montiniaceae: leaves alternate or opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary inferior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers solitary, in cymes or in corymbs; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 4 to 5; stamens 3 to 5; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
